_about: Meaning, unit and kind of each CSV column. Facts come from the UCI page as read by the owner; nothing is filled from memory. Every entry stays verified:false until the owner confirms it. Columns not listed here are not described yet.

TP3.meaning: pressure generated at the pneumatic panel (system pressure the train uses)
TP3.source: UCI page variable table, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

MPG.meaning: starts the compressor under load when pressure drops below 8.2 bar
MPG.source: UCI page, as supplied by the owner in chat on 2026-10-19

Motor_current.meaning: motor current; states: about 0 A off, 4 A offloaded, 7 A under load, 9 A starting
